features.text: Patient reports high blood sugar levels, with readings in the 300s.
Patient states that their blood sugar levels have been creeping up slightly.
Patient reports no significant changes in diet.
Patient states that their diet consists mostly of fruit as a source of sugar.
Patient reports a bit of joint pain in the right knee.
Patient reports nausea a few days ago, but attributes it to sitting in the back of a car.
Patient denies recent fever, chills, body aches, or vomiting.
Patient reports that reflux symptoms have improved and no longer wake up at night with reflux.
Patient denies significant sleep issues, but prefers to sleep on their side.
Patient reports that their sleep quality is surprisingly good now.

Physical examination reveals an enlarged thyroid, clear lungs, a regular heart rhythm, a soft abdomen, erythema and an insect bite with fluctuance on the right knee, and lower extremity edema on the right side.
Patient confirms they have eaten meat in the past couple of days.
Patient expresses concern about alpha-gal syndrome but is reassured by the doctor.
